message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients you’ll need. Feel free to tweak quantities or add extras to suit your taste!

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for 8‑10 servings) |
|----------|------------|------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna Noodles** | Regular or no‑boil lasagna sheets | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat Sauce** | • Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 ½ lb (680 g) |
| | • Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | • Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | • Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | • Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | • Red wine (optional) | ½ cup |
| | • Dried oregano | 1 tsp |
| | • Dried basil | 1 tsp |
| | • Salt & pepper | to taste |
| | • Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| **Ricotta Mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup |
| | Fresh parsley, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt & pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel (White Sauce)** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk (whole or 2%) | 4 cups |
| | Nutmeg (freshly grated) | pinch |
| | Salt & pepper | to taste |
| **Cheese Layer** | Shredded mozzarella | 2 cups |
| | Grated Parmesan (top layer) | ½ cup |
| **Optional Extras** | Spinach, sautéed | 2 cups |
| | Mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup |
| | Bell pepper, diced | ½ cup |
| | Red pepper flakes | pinch (for heat) |

### Quick Prep Tips
1. **Cook the noodles** according to package instructions (or use no‑boil sheets to skip this step). Drain and set aside.
2. **Make the meat sauce**: Sauté onion & garlic in olive oil until translucent, add ground meat, cook until browned, then stir in tomatoes, wine, herbs, and seasonings. Simmer 20–30 min.
3. **Prepare the ricotta mixture**: Combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, parsley, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
4. **Whip up the béchamel**: Melt butter, whisk in flour until smooth, gradually add milk while whisking to avoid lumps. Cook until thickened, season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
5. **Assemble**: In a baking dish, spread a thin layer of meat sauce, lay noodles, dollop ricotta mixture, drizzle béchamel, sprinkle mozzarella, repeat layers, finishing with sauce, béchamel, mozzarella, and Parmesan on top.
6. **Bake**: Cover with foil (to prevent sticking, press foil against the cheese surface) and bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min. Remove foil and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden.
7. **Rest**: Let it sit 10–15 min before slicing to keep the layers intact.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna! 🍝
